purpose: Operator-managed per-worker capacity failures; all other errors retain global halt
program:
import sys,pathlib,json,inspect
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/work/equivoque-recovery')
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'work/expansion'))
import expanded as e
old_write=e.write_json
def isolate_capacity(path,data):
    path=pathlib.Path(path)
    state=inspect.currentframe().f_back.f_locals.get('state')
    turns=state.get('turns',[]) if state else []
    if path.name=='HALT.json' and state and turns and any(
        ev.get('type')=='turn.failed' and 'selected model is at capacity' in json.dumps(ev.get('error',{})).lower()
        for ev in turns[-1].get('events',[])):
        target=e.CONTROLS/'capacity-errors'/(state['scratch_id']+'.json')
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        old_write(target,{**data,'capacity_only':True,'trial_id':state['trial']['trial_id'],
                         'configuration_id':state['trial']['configuration_id'],
                         'scratch_id':state['scratch_id'],'events':state['turns'][-1].get('events',[])[-2:]})
        return
    old_write(path,data)
e.write_json=isolate_capacity
if __name__=='__main__':sys.exit(e.worker(sys.argv[1]))
